en.baptism: In the year one thousand nine hundred and six, on the 19th day of November, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church [words garbled] [priest not given] baptised an infant named Władysław with all the rites of the Sacrament.
en.parents: Son of Kazimierz, son of Antoni, and Barbara née Peikas, Pocesas, lawfully married peasants of Bernatovo district, born on the 12th of November 1906 in the town of Plungė.
en.godparents: The godparents were Kazimierz Kuchinskii and [name missing], a maiden.
